a.lede: Microsoft is giving its Copilot app another facelift.
a.title: Microsoft's Copilot app adds Office, natural coding and automation

b.lede: Microsoft is revamping Copilot into a singular AI workspace, mixing your projects and agents together. It will also be able to support third-party frontier models.
b.title: Microsoft revamps Copilot with new tools, support for frontier models
